findings.evidence: The declarations at lines 174, 202, and 232 carry `@[expose]`; their public restatements occur at lines 192, 205, and 235 respectively.
findings.fix: Remove all three `@[expose]` annotations and use the existing characteristic lemmas downstream; adjust trivial proofs to `:= (rfl)` where needed without exposing bodies.
findings.issue: `twistedGroupAlgebra`, `TwistedGroupAlgebra.of` (line 202), and `TwistedGroupAlgebra.basis` (line 232) are all `@[expose]`, making consumers depend on the span/subtype construction despite having `toSubmodule_twistedGroupAlgebra`, `coe_of`, and `basis_apply` characterization lemmas.

findings.evidence: Lines 91–94 declare the two equations, while proofs at lines 137 and 160 must invoke them explicitly.
findings.issue: The normalization projections `IsFactorSet.one_left` and `one_right` are canonical normal-form equations but lack `@[simp]`, so basic expressions `α 1 g` and `α g 1` do not simplify through the public factor-set API.

summary: The public surface exposes implementation bodies unnecessarily and omits simp normalization for the factor-set interface.
